import sys
sys.path.append('storage')
from telos import aos_manager

TICK_TO_LOG = 96

aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="modify_code",
    target="aos_manager.py",
    metadata={"purpose": "Fix output directory creation bug"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="test_aos",
    target="generate_self_report.py (Corrected)",
    metadata={"eval_id": 230, "status": "success"}
)
aos_manager.log_structured_action(
    tick=TICK_TO_LOG,
    type="log_actions",
    target="ticks_94_95",
    metadata={"eval_id": 231, "purpose": "Batch correction"}
)
